system.description: The Baali engages the target in a Mental Challenge, bidding Traits according to the depth of secret knowledge sought. One Trait risked reveals a small weakness or transgression (low Willpower, low Virtues, or a Negative Trait). Two Traits reveal a dangerous secret or undiscovered crime. Three Traits expose derangements, flaws, past diablerie, or other deeply hidden sin. The Storyteller decides exactly what is learned and phrases it subjectively.
